method.width: FWHM of normalized R/G darkness across perpendicular 21-pixel profiles; median of 11 central cross sections (30-70% edge length), then median across three confident screenshots.
method.meaning: Observed raster width, not traversal multiplicity. No classification is fitted to Euler success.

all.warning: K-means always produces two clusters even on a continuous distribution; this is not proof of two physical stroke widths.

H.warning: K-means always produces two clusters even on a continuous distribution; this is not proof of two physical stroke widths.

V.warning: K-means always produces two clusters even on a continuous distribution; this is not proof of two physical stroke widths.

classification.interpretation: Two well-separated raster width groups are observed in both orientations, with a small tail of extra-wide strokes. Thickness alone does not establish repeat count or authoring intent.

solver.criterion: The original graph must be connected. In the graph of permitted doubling edges, including isolated original vertices, count components containing an odd number of original odd-degree vertices. A trail exists iff this count is 0 or 2.
solver.construction: Spanning-forest T-join; each permitted edge is doubled at most once. Hierholzer traversal of the resulting multigraph. No shortest-route claim.

variants.A: Every original edge traversed once; only measured thick edges may receive a second traversal.
variants.B: Every original edge traversed once; only measured thin edges may receive a second traversal.

strictMeaning.A: Every thick edge exactly twice, every thin edge exactly once; control, not the optional-repeat request.
strictMeaning.B: Every thin edge exactly twice, every thick edge exactly once; control, not the optional-repeat request.
